---
title: "Assembly of Eucalyptus x phylacis ONT Reads"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
readr::write_lines(c("", "---------  Nuclear Assembly  -------"),
                   file=fn_log, append=T)

# create output directories
outdir_hifiasm                 <- file.path(currentdir, "02_hifiasm")
outdir_hifiasm_assembly        <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm, "01_assembly")
outdir_hifiasm_corrected_reads <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "corrected_reads")

outdir_hifiasm_dotplot         <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm, "02_dotplot")
outdir_hifiasm_blobtools       <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm, "03_blobtools")
outdir_blobtools_minimap       <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "minimap")
outdir_blobtools_compleasm     <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "compleasm")
outdir_blobtools_taxdump       <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "taxdump")

sapply(c(outdir_hifiasm_corrected_reads, outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, outdir_blobtools_minimap, outdir_blobtools_compleasm, outdir_blobtools_taxdump), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# output files
fn_hap1_gfa  <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "hifiasm_asm.bp.hap1.p_ctg.gfa")
fn_hap2_gfa  <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "hifiasm_asm.bp.hap2.p_ctg.gfa")
fn_hap1      <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "hifiasm_asm.bp.hap1.p_ctg.fa")
fn_hap2      <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "hifiasm_asm.bp.hap2.p_ctg.fa")
fn_hap_union <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, "hifiasm_asm.union.fa")

# download BUSCO lineage
dir_busco_lineage <- file.path(currentdir, "busco_lineages")
if (!dir.exists(file.path(dir_busco_lineage, "eudicotyledons_odb12")) || params$redo) {
    unlink(dir_busco_lineage, recursive=T)

    system(paste(params$exe_compleasm, "download",
                 "-L", dir_busco_lineage,
                 "--odb odb12 eudicotyledons"))
}

# download tax_dump
if (length(list.files(outdir_blobtools_taxdump)) == 0 || params$redo) {
    setwd(outdir_blobtools_taxdump)
    system("curl -L https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/taxonomy/new_taxdump/new_taxdump.tar.gz | tar xzf -")
    setwd(currentdir)
}
```

## Hifiasm

```{r hifiasm}
# run hifiasm
if (!all(file.exists(fn_hap1, fn_hap2)) || params$redo) {
    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Running hifiasm...")

    f_hifiasm(fn_fastq       = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
              dir_out        = outdir_hifiasm_assembly,
              hifiasm_params = "-l 3 -s 0.50 --telo-m AAACCCT --hom-cov 55",
              thread         = params$thread,
              exe_hifiasm    = params$exe_hifiasm)
    
    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Finished!")

    # convert GFA to FA
    system(paste(params$exe_gfatools, "gfa2fa", fn_hap1_gfa, ">", fn_hap1))
    system(paste(params$exe_gfatools, "gfa2fa", fn_hap2_gfa, ">", fn_hap2))

    # index both haplotypes
    system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_hap1))
    system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_hap2))

    # extract corrected reads
    setwd(outdir_hifiasm_corrected_reads)

    # link to the previous output files
    for (suffix in c("ec.bin", "ovlp.source.bin", "ovlp.reverse.bin")) {
        system(paste("ln -s", file.path("..", paste0("hifiasm_asm.", suffix)), "."))
    }

    # extract corrected reads
    system(paste(params$exe_hifiasm,
                 "-o hifiasm_asm",
                 "-t", params$thread,
                 "--ont --write-ec",
                 fn_filtered_fastqgz))

    setwd(currentdir)
}

# generate a dotplot between the two haplotypes
if (!file.exists(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2.paf")) || params$redo) {
    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap1,
                   minimap_params = "-x asm20 -N 1000 --secondary=no",
                   fn_query       = fn_hap2,
                   fn_out         = file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2.paf"),
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
}

if (!file.exists(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.png")) || params$redo) {
    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Generating dotplot between hap1 and hap2...")

    cmd_dotplot <- paste("Rscript",
                         file.path(params$codedir, "scripts", "pafCoordsDotPlotly.R"),
                         "-i", file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2.paf"),
                         "-o", file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2_dotplot"),
                         "-s -t")
    system(cmd_dotplot)

    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Finished!")

    # move the plot and HTML to the destined folder
    if (!file.exists(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.png")) && file.exists(file.path(currentdir, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.png"))) {
        file.rename(from = file.path(currentdir, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.png"),  to = file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.png"))
        file.rename(from = file.path(currentdir, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.html"), to = file.path(outdir_hifiasm_dotplot, "hap1_hap2_dotplot.html"))
    }
}

# generate the union
system(paste("cat", fn_hap1, fn_hap2, ">", fn_hap_union))
system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_hap_union))

# map filtered ONT reads to each haploptype
fn_bam_hap1 <- file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, "hap1.bam")
fn_bam_hap2 <- file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, "hap2.bam")

if (!all(file.exists(fn_bam_hap1, fn_bam_hap2)) || params$redo) {
    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Mapping reads to each haplotype...")

    f_minimap2_bam(fn_ref         = fn_hap1,
                   minimap_params = "-ax lr:hq",
                   fn_query       = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
                   fn_out         = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, "hap1.bam"),
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap,
                   exe_samtools   = params$exe_samtools)
    f_minimap2_bam(fn_ref         = fn_hap2,
                   minimap_params = "-ax lr:hq",
                   fn_query       = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
                   fn_out         = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, "hap2.bam"),
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap,
                   exe_samtools   = params$exe_samtools)
    
    # update log file
    log4r::info(fn_logger, "Finished!")
}
```

## BlobTools

```{r blobtools, eval=params$run_blobtools, include=params$run_blobtools}
# output directories
dir_hap1_btk <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "hap1_btk")
dir_hap2_btk <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "hap2_btk")

# update log file
log4r::info(fn_logger, "Running BlobTools...")

# build the Blobdir
f_blobtools_create(fn_fasta      = fn_hap1,
                   taxid         = 3932,
                   dir_taxdump   = outdir_blobtools_taxdump,
                   dir_out       = dir_hap1_btk,
                   exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)
f_blobtools_create(fn_fasta      = fn_hap2,
                   taxid         = 3932,
                   dir_taxdump   = outdir_blobtools_taxdump,
                   dir_out       = dir_hap2_btk,
                   exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)

# add coverage
f_blobtools_add_bam(dir_blobtools = dir_hap1_btk,
                    fn_bam        = fn_bam_hap1,
                    thread        = params$thread,
                    exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)
f_blobtools_add_bam(dir_blobtools = dir_hap2_btk,
                    fn_bam        = fn_bam_hap2,
                    thread        = params$thread,
                    exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)

# compleasm
f_compleasm(fn_fasta          = fn_hap1,
            dir_out           = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap1"),
            dir_busco_lineage = dir_busco_lineage,
            thread            = params$thread,
            exe_compleasm     = params$exe_compleasm)
f_compleasm(fn_fasta          = fn_hap2,
            dir_out           = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap2"),
            dir_busco_lineage = dir_busco_lineage,
            thread            = params$thread,
            exe_compleasm     = params$exe_compleasm)

# change compleasm output table to follow BlobTools requirements
f_update_compleasm_table(fn_input  = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap1", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "full_table_busco_format.tsv" ),
                         fn_output = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap1", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "hap1_busco_btk.tsv"))
f_update_compleasm_table(fn_input  = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap2", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "full_table_busco_format.tsv" ),
                         fn_output = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap2", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "hap2_busco_btk.tsv"))

# add BUSCO completeness
f_blobtools_add_busco(dir_blobtools = dir_hap1_btk,
                      fn_busco      = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap1", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "hap1_busco_btk.tsv"),
                      exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)
f_blobtools_add_busco(dir_blobtools = dir_hap2_btk,
                      fn_busco      = file.path(outdir_blobtools_compleasm, "hap2", "eudicotyledons_odb12", "hap2_busco_btk.tsv"),
                      exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)

# check if BLAST database exists
if (any(file.exists(paste0(params$blast_nt_db, ".nal"), params$blast_prot_db))) {
    # create the output directory
    outdir_blobtools_blast <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "blast")
    if (!dir.exists(outdir_blobtools_blast)) {
        dir.create(outdir_blobtools_blast, recursive=T)
    }

    # generate 100kb sliding-windows
    system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "sliding",
                "-s 100000 -W 100000",
                "-g", fn_hap1,
                ">", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.chunks.fa")))
    system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "sliding",
                "-s 100000 -W 100000",
                "-g", fn_hap2,
                ">", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.chunks.fa")))

    # initiate variables
    ls_hits_hap1 <- NULL
    ls_hits_hap2 <- NULL

    # blastn
    if (file.exists(paste0(params$blast_nt_db, ".nal"))) {
        f_blastn(fn_query   = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.chunks.fa"),
                 fn_db      = params$blast_nt_db,
                 fn_out     = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.blastn.out"),
                 thread     = params$thread,
                 exe_blastn = params$exe_blastn)
        f_blastn(fn_query   = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.chunks.fa"),
                 fn_db      = params$blast_nt_db,
                 fn_out     = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.blastn.out"),
                 thread     = params$thread,
                 exe_blastn = params$exe_blastn)

        # add BLAST hits
        ls_hits_hap1 <- c(ls_hits_hap1, paste("--hits", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.blastn.out")))
        ls_hits_hap2 <- c(ls_hits_hap2, paste("--hits", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.blastn.out")))
    }

    # diamond
    if (file.exists(params$blast_prot_db)) {
        f_diamond(fn_query    = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.chunks.fa"),
                  fn_db       = params$blast_prot_db,
                  fn_out      = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.diamond.out"),
                  thread      = params$thread,
                  exe_diamond = params$exe_diamond)
        f_diamond(fn_query    = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.chunks.fa"),
                  fn_db       = params$blast_prot_db,
                  fn_out      = file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.diamond.out"),
                  thread      = params$thread,
                  exe_diamond = params$exe_diamond)
        
        # add BLAST hits
        ls_hits_hap1 <- c(ls_hits_hap1, paste("--hits", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap1.diamond.out")))
        ls_hits_hap2 <- c(ls_hits_hap2, paste("--hits", file.path(outdir_blobtools_blast, "hap2.diamond.out")))
    }

    # add BLAST hits to Blobdir
    if (!is.null(ls_hits_hap1) && !is.null(ls_hits_hap2)) {
        f_blobtools_add_hits(dir_blobtools = dir_hap1_btk,
                             hits          = paste(ls_hits_hap1, collapse=" "),
                             dir_taxdump   = outdir_blobtools_taxdump,
                             exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)
        f_blobtools_add_hits(dir_blobtools = dir_hap2_btk,
                             hits          = paste(ls_hits_hap2, collapse=" "),
                             dir_taxdump   = outdir_blobtools_taxdump,
                             exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools)
    }
}

# export output
f_blobtools_export(dir_blobtools = dir_hap1_btk,
                   dir_out       = outdir_hifiasm_blobtools,
                   prefix        = "hap1",
                   exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools,
                   exe_blobtk    = params$exe_blobtk)
f_blobtools_export(dir_blobtools = dir_hap2_btk,
                   dir_out       = outdir_hifiasm_blobtools,
                   prefix        = "hap2",
                   exe_blobtools = params$exe_blobtools,
                   exe_blobtk    = params$exe_blobtk)

# update log file
log4r::info(fn_logger, "Finished!")
```
